messages:
kevin: Heads-up: after we applied the tighter NACLs in ap-northeast-1 and the automated KMS rotation window, several GPU warm-pool nodes failed to complete keystore handshakes and stalled during join. Example from node logs:
```
2026-05-03T01:12:07Z node-init ERROR keystore decrypt failed: Network unreachable to privatelink endpoint (EPIPE)
2026-05-03T01:12:09Z warmup WARN join attempt 2 -> backoff
```
This is hitting capacity runway for several prod jobs.

maria: seeing same in ap-northeast-1 and ap-southeast-1. NAT gateway conntrack is high, but more interestingly some decrypts are returning 403 because requests are routed via fallback NAT instead of privatelink. NACL blocks ephemeral ENI ranges.

hao: Root cause: KMS rotation caused keystore-proxy to re-establish sessions. Keystore clients create ephemeral ENIs in keystore subnets; our NACL tighten dropped those source IP ranges for privatelink egress. We also had an IAM condition restricting to sourceVpcEndpointId which rejects NAT-originated traffic.

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-warmup-join-fail-rate > 7% (10m). keystore-decrypt-p95 = 88s.

rachel: Mitigation plan (minimal blast radius): 1) add transient NACL allow rule for keystore ENI CIDR 10.233.200.0/22 outbound to privatelink endpoints (port 443) for 45m 2) reduce audit exporter sampling to 25% to stop S3 PUT amplification 3) enqueue terraform change to whitelist keystore-tagged ENIs in egress policies with TTL and audit gate. If this doesn't fix in 30m, fallback: rollback NACL tighten.

kevin: CLI to add ephemeral NACL entry (will scope to the specific subnet):
```
aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0a1b2c3d --rule-number 110 --protocol tcp --port-range From=443,To=443 --egress --cidr-block 10.233.200.0/22 --rule-action allow
```
I'll coordinate the change and add a revert timer.

maria: cost estimate: if we need to scale warm-pool by +3 in each APAC region to absorb lag, that's ~ $5.5k/day/region. Sampling reduces S3 retry cost ~ $4k/day. Try to keep window <1h.

hao: I'll open infra PR with a canary that decrypts via a tagged ENI before rotation and include pre-seed of NACL entries in the rotation playbook. Also adding a health metric that flags fallback-to-NAT routes.

ops-bot: action: audit-sampler -> 25% (deploy id ds-77441). NACL change applied to staging; warmup canaries passed. Applying to prod in 3m.

kevin: Prod patch applied. 20m in: keystore decrypt p95 down to ~250ms, warm-pool join failures back to baseline. Leaving monitoring window 1h. Please link PRs to the KMS rotation runbook and add this NACL pre-seed step.

cost-bot: NOTE: projected incremental cost if extended >3h = ~$16k across APAC. Keep window short.

rachel: Agreed. Postmortem checklist: update rotation runbook, add ENI pre-seed and pre-rotation canary, and add automated rollback for NACL tighten. Thanks all :thumbsup:
